title: Gradient-extrapolation-based distributed mirror descent algorithm for multi-cluster aggregative games
summary: This paper studies a class of multi-cluster aggregative games characterized by the coexistence of cooperation and competition, where each agent's cost function depends on its own strategy and the aggregate of all agents' strategies. To address the Nash equilibrium seeking problem for such games in the non-Euclidean setting, a distributed mirror descent algorithm with gradient extrapolation is proposed over time-varying intra-cluster and inter-cluster networks.
